Tomato___healthy.name: Tomato
Tomato___healthy.care_tips: Water regularly. Ensure full sun exposure.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.name: Tomato
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Remove affected leaves. Apply fungicide if necessary.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.care_tips: Improve air circulation. Avoid overhead watering.

Tomato___Late_blight.name: Tomato
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicide. Remove infected plants.
Tomato___Late_blight.care_tips: Avoid wetting leaves. Rotate crops regularly.
